BiblicalUsage: Zeboim was a place in Benjamin — a valley and a town. One company of Philistine raiders turned toward the valley of Zeboim in Saul's day, and after the exile men of Benjamin lived in Zeboim again. It is a different Zeboim from the city of the plain, a Benjamin town with its own story.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the small towns in the record, and Zeboim's two mentions — a raid and a return — frame the whole story of Benjamin. The town that saw invaders also saw exiles come home.
